integrity: Analytic proof with a stand-alone finite numerical diagnostic; independent validation not performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for one-dimensional inverse-square and inverse-cube kernels with smooth even-first-jet positive numerators and fixed interior Gauss–Legendre nodes; it does not compare adaptive or multidimensional algorithms and is not uniform in quadrature order. Two related full primary texts were only available in abstracts/summaries.
title: A fixed-budget near-singularity reversal for hypergeometric Gaussian quadrature
